changeSet.comment: Enable REASONING capability for specific GROK models
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ai_models_capability (model_id, capability_id, enabled) SELECT m.id, c.id, true FROM ai_models m, ai_capability c WHERE m.provider = 'GROK' AND m.model = 'grok-4-1-fast-reasoning' AND c.type = 'REASONING' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled);
